figurative_meaning_bn: ক্রিকেট খেলায় বল করার এক কৌশল
figurative_meaning_en: A deceptive bowling technique in cricket
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গুগলি দেখে ব্যাটার একদম বিভ্রান্ত হয়ে গেল।
এই ম্যাচে তার গুগলি খুব কার্যকর হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The batsman was completely deceived by his googly.
His googly was very effective in this match.
history: The googly was invented by English cricketer Bernard Bosanquet around 1891 as a variation of the ordinary leg break to deceive batsmen.
note: This is a loanword from English 'googly', widely used in Bengali cricket commentary and discussions.
